articles.content: Major TV networks were notified on Friday that the department was examining whether they violated antitrust laws when they suspended pool coverage of President Trump.

articles.title: Anthropic Agents Tried to Fill Out Visa Forms on State Dept. Website
articles.description: The Philadelphia Police Department said the agents had also sent in a false homicide tip. The incidents led the White House to call for better disclosure of rogue A.I. behavior.
